description_target.target_text: Rotate and permute the tiles until the touching edge-center colors match across both internal boundaries of a 2×2 mosaic. Output that assembled mosaic.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Four 3x3 tiles sit on a maroon(9) divider lattice. Reassemble them
 ;; as a 2x2 jigsaw: try every tile permutation and rotation until the
 ;; touching edge midpoints agree, then output the assembled board
 ;; (dividers included), lexicographically smallest solution first.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (flat grid) (apply append grid))
     (define (lex< a b)
       (cond ((empty? a) (not (empty? b)))
             ((empty? b) #f)
             ((not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b)))
             (else (lex< (rest a) (rest b)))))
     (define (remove-one x xs)
       (cond ((empty? xs) (list))
             ((equal? x (first xs)) (rest xs))
             (else (cons (first xs) (remove-one x (rest xs))))))
     (define (permutations-list xs)
       (if (empty? xs)
           (list (list))
           (flatmap (lambda (x)
                      (map (lambda (p) (cons x p))
                           (permutations-list (remove-one x xs))))
                    xs)))
     (define (segments n dividers)  ;; (start end-exclusive) spans
       (let loop ((ds (append dividers (list n))) (prev -1)
                  (acc (list)))
         (if (empty? ds)
             (reverse acc)
             (loop (rest ds) (first ds)
                   (if (> (- (first ds) prev 1) 0)
                       (cons (list (+ prev 1) (first ds)) acc)
                       acc)))))
     (define tiles
       (let ((rbs (segments h (filter (lambda (r)
                                        (all? (lambda (c)
                                                (= (at g r c) 9))
                                              (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h))))
             (cbs (segments w (filter (lambda (c)
                                        (all? (lambda (r)
                                                (= (at g r c) 9))
                                              (range 0 h)))
                                      (range 0 w)))))
         (flatmap (lambda (rb)
                    (map (lambda (cb)
                           (subgrid g (first rb) (first cb)
                                    (- (second rb) 1)
                                    (- (second cb) 1)))
                         cbs))
                  rbs)))
     (define (rotk tile k)
       (cond ((= (modulo k 4) 1) (rotate-cw tile))
             ((= (modulo k 4) 2) (rotate-180 tile))
             ((= (modulo k 4) 3) (rotate-ccw tile))
             (else tile)))
     (define (assemble t0 t1 t2 t3)  ;; 2x2 with 1-wide 9 dividers
       (let ((th (rows t0)) (tw (cols t0)))
         (for*/fold ((out (empty-grid (+ (* 2 th) 1) (+ (* 2 tw) 1) 9)))
                    ((rr (in-range 2)) (cc (in-range 2))
                     (r (in-range th)) (c (in-range tw)))
           (set-cell out (+ (* rr (+ th 1)) r) (+ (* cc (+ tw 1)) c)
                     (at (nth (list t0 t1 t2 t3) (+ (* rr 2) cc))
                         r c)))))
     (define (edges-match? t0 t1 t2 t3)
       (and (= (at t0 1 2) (at t1 1 0))
            (= (at t2 1 2) (at t3 1 0))
            (= (at t0 2 1) (at t2 0 1))
            (= (at t1 2 1) (at t3 0 1))))
     (define candidates
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (for*/list ((perm (in-list (permutations-list
                                           (range 0 (length tiles)))))
                           (k0 (in-range 4)) (k1 (in-range 4))
                           (k2 (in-range 4)) (k3 (in-range 4)))
                 (let ((t0 (rotk (nth tiles (first perm)) k0))
                       (t1 (rotk (nth tiles (second perm)) k1))
                       (t2 (rotk (nth tiles (third perm)) k2))
                       (t3 (rotk (nth tiles (fourth perm)) k3)))
                   (and (edges-match? t0 t1 t2 t3)
                        (assemble t0 t1 t2 t3))))))
     (first (sort candidates (lambda (a b) (lex< (flat a) (flat b))))))))
